method: Class names and their module/group were read from the public module listing at docs.juce.com (the /master tree, which the master plan identifies with tag 9.0.4; the pages carry no version string). No source code or source listings were opened. Summaries are original one-line descriptions. Modules past the truncation point were read from the docs.juce.com directory pages (dir_*.html, linked from each module header's file page) and the Classes table of each header's file documentation page; source listings were never opened. Only top-level classes are recorded: nested types and the internal 'detail' directories are left out.
